_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.23 (build 87750, linux64, headless), read with calculate_tile_properties on a Nauvis surface, one named noise expression per row. Positions are 1,024 points on the 1/256 grid (x in [-4096, 4096], y in [-512, 512]) and `bits` is each result as the hex of its f32, in the same order as `positions`. `values` is the shortest decimal that reads back as that f32. Trig is the whole value in every sin/cos row. The terrace rows are terrace{value = x / 10, width = 20, offset, strength}. The pow rows are the three spellings of exponent 0.5 on abs(x) + 0.001. Cross-checked: 2.0.77 (build 84539, linux64, headless) returned bit-identical values. Captured by scripts/probes/native-ops. Graded by Stage 2 (terrace, sin, cos) and Stage 1 (pow).
